transport: One exact existing owner-authorized ADB endpoint; no device enumeration, scan, fallback, or transport change.

legacy_su.mode_risk: HIGH: group and other have write permission bits; eligibility requires current read-only covering mount, exact non-symlink path, and non-writable root-owned parent directories.

privacy.raw_output: Private host path outside the Git worktree, owner-only directory 0700 and files 0600.
privacy.public: Never include raw /proc, endpoint, serial, network addresses, credentials, keys, or session secrets.
privacy.memory_or_secrets: No memory, environ, keys, credentials, decrypted traffic, process attachment, or packet capture.

cleanup: Stop ADB collection, preserve partial host evidence, do not attempt to remove SuperSU daemon/log/policy state; those side effects may persist. Owner restores normal stock CarPlay disconnect and factory UI state through ordinary controls.
